.²1 The foot of a mountain.
.²2 A kind of {#kadamba#} (said to blossom in the rainy season; Adina Cordifolia
 Hook). The tree is known as {#hequ#} or {#heqakadamba#} in Marāthī.
 It is the same as {#haridrakadambaka#} or {#haridraka#}. The wood of the
 tree is yellow and is still found employed in old buildings. {#nIpaH pradIpAyate#}
 <ls>Mk. 5. 14</ls>; {#sImante ca tvadupagamajaM yatra nIpaM vaDUnAm#} <ls>Me. 67</ls>; {#navanIpANkuranandanIyaSoBA#} <ls>Bhār. Ch.</ls>
.²3 A species of Aśoka; a kind of plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>{#dupArI#}</ns>); {#kadambavetasanalanIpavaYjulakErvftam#}
 ({#payaH#}) <ls>Bhāg. 8. 2. 17</ls>.
.²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a family of kings; {#nIpAnvayaH pArTiva eza yajvA#} <ls>R. 6. 46</ls>.

The flower of the Kadamba tree; {#nIpaM dfzwvA haritakapiSaM#}
 {#kEsarErarDarUQEH#} <ls>Me. 21</ls>; <ls>R. 19. 37</ls>.
